merge_method: Source: dublin_core_remaining (lot 2), one sheet per merge_method. Left out: 'no header' and 'failed to download' (3,477 and 1,370 datasets, none downloaded) and 'unverified' (1,303 downloaded datasets whose collection has a member that failed to download).
New Dataset Title = Collection; datasets without one (non-mergeable, to be removed) show new_title.

Year, Month, Financial_Year, Quarter, State: the stored columns (NA = empty). District: taken from the title ('... for X District of Y') where merge_add_columns names district. Other merge_add_columns dimensions (airline, jail_type, ...) have no stored value.
Row counts are only for the datasets that get merged (curate, direct, change_in_header); the non-mergeable and to be removed sheets list the datasets without counts.

row_count = data rows in the downloaded file after one header row, blank rows skipped. csv: records as parsed, so quoted line breaks do not add rows; xls: first non-empty sheet; json: record count. Files that are not tables, or were never downloaded, have no count - see row_count_note.
collection_total_row_count = sum of row_count over the collection's datasets that have a count; it is merged down the collection's rows.
old/new catalogs are distinct counts, so TOTAL is counted over all rows, not summed.
